nodes.label: Debugging and Error Recovery
nodes.rationale: Systematic root-cause debugging with structured triage. Stop-the-Line Rule: stop adding features, preserve evidence, diagnose, fix root cause, guard against recurrence, resume only after verification.

nodes.label: Triage Checklist
nodes.rationale: Six steps in order: Reproduce, Localize, Reduce, Fix Root Cause, Guard Against Recurrence, Verify End-to-End. Do not skip steps. Use bisection (git bisect) for regression bugs.
